summary_1line: Kumbhakarna, awakened from sleep, meets Ravana, who pleads for his help against Rama’s invading monkey army threatening Lanka.

image_candidates.scene_text: The colossal Kumbhakarna strides along the royal road of Lanka while thousands of demons surround him and flowers rain down from palace balconies.
Kumbhakarna enters the golden palace and bows before Ravana seated upon the celestial Pushpaka chariot throne.
Ravana rises anxiously and embraces the towering, red‑eyed Kumbhakarna as he begs his brother to save Lanka from Rama.
